skillSays: Pick one of three modes before starting (Ink Press template, autonomous free creation, guided co-creation); without a stated choice, do only a read-only product check and ask.
Reproducing a product page means real screenshots: a full-page 2x texture, element cutouts and a layout.json, driven by a 2.5D PageCam camera, not hand-built UI.
The film's visual language must grow from the product's own design tokens, and motion tokens come from a brand-to-preset table instead of gut feeling.
Each shot is built from a recipe card plus its tuned demo source; parameters marked as known pitfalls must not be reduced, and one animation technique is the hero only once.
Brand wordmark holds at least one second, everything else breathes; pace is only ever corrected slower; no hand-held shake; lights and glints only for the hero, clipped to rounded edges.
Sound is pinned in a declarative table relative to the timeline after picture lock, and delivery needs an independent clean-context review with frame-numbered findings.
